summary: ADR-0093 reconciles public .github#4517 decisions 6200107860 and 6200287829 for the single original .103 authentication-only operation. Programme owns policy/change control and source review; EHotwagner retains separate App/credential custody. SystemAdmin owns separate supervised ACK-service design and later operational custody outside the key-free facts store and original job/runner/VM; actual signer custody and independent enrollment remain unqualified. Six means six logical phase ordinals. The 65,536-byte total counts the complete signed/schema population, exact frames/ACKs, loss/first-failure/terminal/expiry facts, checkpoints, all simultaneous physical copies, peer control and old/temp/candidate write/replacement uncertainty evidence. Unproved fit or overflow refuses source/runtime admission; required facts cannot be evicted or omitted. Retention ends 90 days after the original total cutoff without read renewal; RetentionExpired/Unknown retains original-effect holds. The earlier unavailable-packet status is historical: SystemAdmin reported restored/read-back-equal private v1/v2 and delivered v3; Programme independently verified received v3 digest. Its 64,000-byte slot arithmetic and ACK topology are only an accepted planning subset, not complete fit or interface freeze; v1 128-frame/131,072-byte design is historical. Programme/fdev1 has a bounded source-only reservation for isolated inert contract, maximum vectors and exhaustive slot/copy accounting; SystemAdmin separately reviews host layout/backend/trust against that exact digest and Programme decides the join. No production provider/workflow or native/credential/release change is admitted. Hold remains on closed signed descriptor/frame/ACK/read schemas and maximum vectors, distinct original publisher/executing authentication identities with original pins, ready ABI 2,048-byte fit, peer irreversible-control/simultaneous-copy algorithm, counted ambiguous-write/loss/expiry states and diagnostic-read versus replacement-gate semantics. Two extra 1,024-byte peer controls would yield 66,048 bytes and refuse. Barrier/fresh exact readback, original-clock continuity/finite uncertainty, signer enrollment/custody and independent loss proof remain unqualified. Preserve one-use gates, original same-token independent HTTP 204, whole-job/runner/VM loss Unknown/unqualified/unretried and original 270/285/300-second cutoffs. All six native selections and admission/effect flags remain false; original .103 tag attempted-unknown/unreplayed, .104 held. Source receipt and reported readiness v10 do not prove native acceptance. Public source-join review 6200296350 adds: legacy child ACK closed keys b,h,k,n,v plus BE-u32 framing are distinct from the external signed ACK. Trusted persistence/readback must authenticate exact issuer/descriptor/frame/ordinal/purpose/original-clock before typed return while preserving TakeAck/ConfirmAckSent one-use/full-write/cutoff checks; echoed fields do not establish authority. Start/ready full framing/wrappers/exact child binding must fit 2,048 bytes; the external 4,096-byte descriptor slot cannot replace it. Their authenticated relationship and maximum wrapped vectors remain unproved.
title: Original .103 authentication domain policy is selected; implementation and effects stay held
